issue_title: [Security] load() path.stat() TOCTOU: file size checked then read, file could change between check and read
fix_summary: Eliminated TOCTOU race condition in TodoStorage.load() by reading file content first, then validating size of in-memory data instead of using stat().
risks: Minor performance impact: content is now encoded twice (once by read_text UTF-8, once by .encode() for size check). This is negligible for the 10MB limit use case.
